Introduction

Momentary button module is a binary input module. Different signals can be sent by short press, long press, press and lift and other actions. Compared to a three-position rocker switch module, a momentary button module has only two states: pressed and flicked up, and it always returns to flicked up. The momentary button module can be used to switch between various modes in a specified order, trigger and stop some actions in real time. For example, triggering a shot on a model with a shooting mechanism, or switching the mode and color of lights on a model with RGB lights.
